Priya D: quick heads-up 99999planning to post internal release note for 2.17.0 at 18:00 PT. need final sign-off on wording for model pin and rollback bullets.
Rob H: dropping the draft now. i'll include exact artifact SHAs and the rbinctl example.
DocsBot: PR link: https://phab/repo/PR-4922 (internal announce + runbook)
deploy-bot: preflight: staging smoke OK, snapshot snap-2026-03-23-1738 created.
oncall-zac: please include a clear kill-switch line and who can trigger it. i'll be on standby 17:45-19:45.
Rob H: added commands into PR:
```
# pin model
rbinctl pin --env=prod --model=model-y --hash=ffee1122
# kill switch (oncall only)
rbinctl traffic --env=prod --set-canary=0
```
Priya D: rollback criteria (short): any one of -> 5m error rate >=2% OR P95 token latency +45% OR >=2 smoke test failures -> set canary=0 and notify #eng-oncall. If two criteria met, escalate to SEV and call owners. full playbook in PR.
Rob H: canary plan: 4% for 15m -> 25% for 15m -> full. Add note about gradual ramp in case memory pressure observed.
Priya D: ops needs final copy by 16:30 PT for the deploybot announcement. can we hit that?
Rob H: yes i'll paste final copy here by 16:15 and lock SHAs by 16:25.
oncall-zac: confirm kill-switch: oncall only, and wait 3 minutes after setting canary=0 to observe stabilization before doing full rollback, per runbook.
Priya D: good call, include that. one-liner for deploybot should be: "Rolling out 2.17.0 to hosted/dedicated. Canary 4% -> 25% -> full. Rollback rules in internal note." keep short.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window 18:00-19:00 PT. quiet-mode notifications set to #eng-oncall.
Rob H: final copy pushed to PR and pasted below.
```
Internal announce: Releasing 2.17.0 at 18:00 PT. Highlights: batching kernel tweaks (reduced tail latency), model pin UI, and console bugfixes. Canary: 4% for 15m -> 25% for 15m -> full. Rollback: set canary=0 on ANY of: 5m error rate >=2% OR P95 latency +45% OR >=2 failed smoke tests; wait 3m after canary=0 to validate metrics. If TWO thresholds met, follow SEV escalation. Owners: Priya D (PM), Rob H (Release Eng), Zac (Oncall). Model hashes and pin commands in PR #4922.
```
oncall-zac: i'm on standby 17:45-19:45. will monitor token_latency.p95, inference.errors/5m, and memory. kill-switch ready.
Priya D: final checklist: (1) ops gets final copy by 16:30 (Rob done), (2) hashes locked by 16:25 (Rob done), (3) oncall confirmed (Zac done), (4) deploybot scheduled (done). i'll post internal blast at 18:05 with the one-liner. thanks team :rocket:
